evidence.title: Upwork In-Demand Skills 2026
evidence.finding: AI integration grew 178% year over year; AI chatbot development grew 71%; applied AI skills overall grew 109%.

evidence.title: Upwork Monthly Hiring Insights — July 2026
evidence.finding: AI automation led AI searches; AI integration, full-stack AI development, computer vision, and creative AI roles showed specialized demand.

evidence.title: AI Agent Developer — Voice, RAG, MCP & Workflow Automation
evidence.finding: A live brief requested Python, LangGraph, voice AI, RAG, MCP, vector databases, FastAPI, integrations, and multi-agent workflows.

evidence.title: AI Engineer — Agents, RAG, MCP, LangChain & OpenAI
evidence.finding: A live expert brief required reliable agents, business-tool integrations, citations, MCP servers, testing, latency/cost work, and production deployment.

evidence.title: McKinsey State of AI 2026
evidence.finding: 40% of large enterprises reported scaling agents, while coding agents and internal AI application development expanded; value remains uneven.

evidence.title: State of Agent Engineering 2026
evidence.finding: Respondents reported production agent growth, with quality and observability as central production concerns and evaluation adoption still lagging.

evidence.title: OpenAI Applied AI Engineer — Agent Enablement
evidence.finding: The role spans connectors, APIs, CLIs, MCP, identity, permissioning, architecture, code, evaluation, failure tracing, launch, and iteration.

evidence.title: LiveKit Staff Product Manager — Agent Hosting
evidence.finding: The role emphasizes deploying and operating realtime agents with reliability, latency, autoscaling, regional coverage, and usage-based economics.

evidence.title: Hello Patient AI Agent Product Manager
evidence.finding: The role owns customer requirements through production launch for healthcare voice, SMS, and chat agents, including guardrails, tools, and evaluations.

evidence.title: Netlify credit-based Free plan
evidence.finding: The connected account has 300 monthly credits, a hard no-overage limit, unlimited deploy previews, serverless functions/storage, and CDN delivery.

opportunityMap.name: AI integration & workflow engineering
opportunityMap.why: Buyers increasingly specify integration, full-stack AI, automation, and production ownership rather than generic prompting.

opportunityMap.name: Agent evaluation, reliability & observability
opportunityMap.why: Quality, failure tracing, permissions, and regression evidence are recurring implementation and role requirements.

opportunityMap.name: RAG, search & governed knowledge
opportunityMap.why: Direct briefs request RAG and citations; enterprise knowledge work remains a leading agent use case.

opportunityMap.name: Voice and realtime agents
opportunityMap.why: Current roles and projects emphasize latency, reliability, tool execution, healthcare workflows, and operational launch.

opportunityMap.name: MCP, permissions & agent enablement
opportunityMap.why: MCP appears in current freelance briefs and product-engineering roles alongside identity, permissioning, and safe tool access.

opportunityMap.name: Developer agents & controlled software delivery
opportunityMap.why: Coding agents are scaling, but durable value depends on architecture, testing, review, and repository safety.

opportunityMap.name: Browser/local AI & privacy-preserving inference
opportunityMap.why: Local inference reduces data transmission and recurring API cost, but buyer demand is less directly visible than integration demand.

opportunityMap.name: Multimodal media & computer vision
opportunityMap.why: Marketplace data shows strong AI video/image and computer-vision demand; credible products must add workflow and evaluation depth.

opportunityMap.name: Human-gated industry agents
opportunityMap.why: Adoption is expanding, but governance and ROI remain uneven; bounded workflows with accountable humans are more credible than autonomy claims.
